characters.fandino: a cartoon character with a round head and dot eyes, wearing a large red spanish naval tricorne hat, a blue naval coat with yellow buttons, holding a sword

scenes.text: Did you know that one of the most absurd military conflicts in human history actually started over a severed ear? Two massive global empires collided violently because of a single sliced human appendage.
scenes.prompt: Wide 16:9 landscape view with {fandino} standing in the center pointing at a giant floating stick-figure ear on the left, while a giant British crown sits on the right, and two tiny cartoon character armies face off in the far distant background under bright flat light.

scenes.text: Back in the year seventeen thirty one, a Spanish coast guard captain named Fandiño boarded a British vessel suspected of illegal smuggling off the turbulent waters of the Caribbean Sea.
scenes.prompt: Wide 16:9 view of a wooden ship deck on a calm blue sea, with {fandino} in his blue coat standing in the center, wooden barrels of rum stacked on the left, a wooden cargo crate on the right, and cartoon character sailors mopping the deck in the background.

scenes.text: Captain Fandiño discovered a huge load of illegal contraband onboard, drew his sharp steel sword, and sliced off British captain Robert Jenkins' ear as a brutal and humiliating warning punishment.
scenes.prompt: Wide 16:9 shot on the ship deck where {fandino} raises his sword in the center, a terrified cartoon character sailor holding his ear on the left, wooden cargo crates stacked on the right, and seagulls flying in the cloudy sky far behind them.

scenes.text: To make matters worse, the Spanish captain mockingly told Jenkins to take his sliced ear directly to the British king as a stern warning against any future illegal trade attempts.
scenes.prompt: Wide 16:9 view on a sunny tropical dock, {fandino} gesturing with his hand on the center-left, a British cartoon character captain holding a small glass jar on the right, tropical palm trees on the far left, and a large galleon anchored in the background water.

scenes.text: Jenkins carefully preserved his severed ear inside a glass jar filled with alcohol, waiting seven long years before finally presenting this disgusting piece of physical evidence to furious British politicians.
scenes.prompt: Wide 16:9 view inside a grand British Parliament hall with wooden benches, a British cartoon character holding up a glass jar on the center table, {fandino} watching from a framed portrait on the left wall, angry cartoon character politicians on the right, and tall stained-glass windows in the background.

scenes.text: British parliamentarians seized upon the famous jar as the ultimate excuse to officially declare war on Spain, aiming to seize control of valuable oceanic trade routes across the lucrative Americas.
scenes.prompt: Wide 16:9 view of a war room with a large wooden map table in the center, cartoon character politicians shouting on the left, a giant map of the Caribbean pinned on the right wall, and colorful military banners hanging from the ceiling in the background.

scenes.text: This bizarre armed conflict lasted nearly ten long years and claimed thousands of human lives, all tragically triggered by nothing more than a single ear sliced off on the open sea.
scenes.prompt: Wide 16:9 landscape view of a battle aftermath with two tiny cartoon character armies marching away in the background, a velvet pillow in the center holding a small glass jar with an ear, palm trees on the left, and a sinking ship on the right horizon.
